data.description:
## What
Create fixture-based end-to-end integration tests for the stateful re-review pipeline.

## Changes
1. Fetch PR #65 and PR #62 diffs:
   gh pr diff 65 > tests/fixtures/review-convergence/pr-65.diff (or use synthetic if gh unavailable)
   gh pr diff 62 > tests/fixtures/review-convergence/pr-62.diff
2. Create prior-cycle findings JSON for each fixture:
   tests/fixtures/review-convergence/pr-65-prior-findings.json
   tests/fixtures/review-convergence/pr-62-prior-findings.json
3. Create test harness: tests/integration/test-review-convergence.sh
   - For each fixture: run ci-llm-review-runner.sh with MOCK_LLM=true (stub), check output
   - Test assertions (mocked):
     (a) RESUSTAIN_OF + proximity overlap -> arbiter dispatch count=1
     (b) NEW_INTRODUCED on overlapping lines without escape_rationale -> Call 2 redispatch
4. MOCK_LLM stub: inject pre-canned findings JSON via env var or stdin to avoid real LLM calls

## Acceptance Criteria
- test -d tests/fixtures/review-convergence/
- bash tests/integration/test-review-convergence.sh passes (GREEN)
- Tests are hermetic (no real LLM calls; MOCK_LLM=true stub path)
data.title: GREEN: fixture-based E2E CI validation harness with PR diff fixtures
